annotation.bound_parties_text: The CAD contains standards, requirements and procedures for individuals and operators in Malaysia seeking approval for Special UAS Project operations, including UAS operators and remote pilots.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This CAD contains the standards, requirements and procedures to individuals and operators in Malaysia seeking approval for operations categorised as ‘Special UAS Project’.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This CAD is applicable to Special UAS Project operations utilising an Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS).
